L75-101 row container: web role=row/tabIndex/aria-selected + DOM click/keydown control-bubbling guard -> Pressable role=button with accessibilityState.selected and onPress=onActivate; inner controls are separate Pressables so a control tap never reaches the row (structural equivalent of target.closest('button,a,input,label')); Enter/Space activation covered by accessibilityRole=button.

L103-109 checkbox; L111-145 rowMain (severity badge, timestamp via TimeStamp in=tzMode, vehicle display_name||#id, rule.name, title read/unread weight, optional message) all rendered with null-safe guards.

Web hover-reveal (opacity-0 group-hover) and the `hidden sm:inline` label are not applicable on native touch; actions stay visible and the label renders alongside the chevron (accessibilityLabel preserved) — consistent with the sibling InboxBody native port.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
